description: Open Data Access Tools is code for using the Open Energy Data Initiative's cloud-hosted energy research datasets. Its README describes Python tools and notebooks for finding and working with data aggregated from US Department of Energy programmes, national laboratories and partners. Users choose an OEDI dataset and configure its documented cloud access path; outputs are local analysis-ready references or tables from that source. Geographic coverage varies by chosen dataset. The repository licence text states BSD-3-Clause terms for the tools, while underlying datasets retain their own provider conditions. A limitation is that access code does not make all OEDI datasets complete, current or equally documented; some analyses need large cloud data transfers that this review did not perform. The tools can prepare solar, wind, building or grid inputs for energy infrastructure simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model consumes such inputs but does not supply this OEDI client. No datasets, notebooks or cloud assets were downloaded.
